newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks battered in higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks battered in higher turnover.

text.p: Croatian stocks took another battering on Thursday with nearly all active issues falling in higher turnover.
* Turnover doubled to 6.8 million kuna, although volume rose very slightly to 5,892 shares.
* Of 15 traded stocks 12 fell, two rose and one was flat.
* Most active was Zagrebacka Banka with 2,891 ordinary shares sold. It rose 30 kuna or 1.5 percent to close at 2,030 kuna.
* Bigger of the two gainers was Karlovacka Pivovara brewery, adding 6.45 percent to 330 kuna on volume of 188.
* Biggest loser hotelier Suncani Hvar dipped 5.26 percent to 54 kuna with 385 shares changing hands.
